title: Fix a reduction with 2-way then 4-way bank conflicts (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C: a single-block 256-element tree reduction. The shipped kernel computes the exact right sum but uses interleaved addressing (index = 2*stride*tid) whose bank-conflict degree doubles every step (2-way, 4-way, 8-way, ...), measuring 150 smem_waves; sequential addressing (stride halves, tid < stride active) on the same input measures 45.
